description_en: A shallow hinged rectangular woven suitcase with wood frame, leather carry handle and two blank metal latches. Canonical front: two latches and leather edge strips on the broad shell. Side view: the top carry handle and continuous hinge seam. Rear view: the broad woven rear shell and two protected hinge plates. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the canonical FRONT reference of this exact product. Create ONE photorealistic alternate catalog view of THAT SAME OBJECT, rotating viewpoint only. Style Rustic: sturdy handmade character and visible bindings. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: regular open hexagonal cane lattice with three strip directions. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact RIGHT-SIDE ELEVATION: orbit camera 90 degrees to the object's right from its canonical front, level with product center. Show its right profile; front-facing panel must be edge-on. Do not merely flip or mirror the front image. Preserve exact silhouette dimensions, finish color, weave, number and locations of all compartments, handles, legs, ribs, drawers, hinges, padding and secondary materials. Reveal the described previously hidden surfaces without redesigning the object. Match background, soft lighting, scale and center placement. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions. CORRECTION TO PREVIOUS SIDE ATTEMPT: the right END WALL is entirely plain woven cane with bound corner posts and leather edge bands. Put NO brass latch plates and NO hinge plates on that right-end wall. The only two latches and leather carry handle are on the opposite broad FRONT WALL shown in the reference; at this strict 90-degree profile the front wall is edge-on at the far left. The only two hinge plates belong on the opposite broad REAR WALL and cannot be visible face-on here. Keep the same squat rectangular suitcase shell, red hexagonal weave, lid height, leather bands and proportions. Show a strict right end elevation, not a redesigned broad wall.
